dutyRateBasis: HTS 9405.11.80 (electric ceiling/wall lighting fittings, other, of base metal or other materials). Column 1 general 3.9% + Section 301 25% + 12.5% forced-labour action = 41.4%. NOT the 55.1% watch-roll stack (HTS 4202.92.97) - different chapter, different rate. VERIFY with a broker before a first commercial order.
verdict: Priced at CA$100.99 in Shopify, which converts to $72.14 at the 1.40 planning rate - under the RULE 2 ceiling of $72.43 (median $62.985 x 1.15). Contributes $40.52/unit under the binding 'prepaid' basis and $7.96 under 'billed', against a $12.00 floor - positive either way, which is the difference between this cohort and the watch rolls. CAUTION: the gate is a floor, not a CPA test. Measured CPA benchmarks run $31.16-$47.93 per order, so a unit at this price covers acquisition only if CPA lands at the lower end.
retailNote: CA$97.00 -> $72.00 USD. REPRICED LIVE 2026-09-11 to clear the RULE 2 breach. Read back from productVariant.contextualPricing(context:{country:US}) after the change, not computed from a planning rate. Still the one EXPOSED offer: $8.05 on the billed basis, under the $12.00 immunity floor. That is a cost problem, not a price one - re-sourcing is the only fix.
supplierSkuUnitCapMethod: Measured 2026-09-09 by the quantity-clamp test: select the exact SKU, type 999 into the quantity box and read the value the page settles on. That is the hard ceiling AliExpress checkout will sell. It is the only per-SKU number that can be trusted - the "Only N left" banner shows a different variant's figure on some pages (this listing displayed "Only 7 left" while the SKU we sell clamped at 888), and the Stock figure on the DSers My Products card is the sum across every variant (it read 9,284 for a listing whose US-plug SKU caps at 9 on other sellers).
costHoldReason: The $23.91 itemCostUsd above is a 52% promotional price, not a list price. Listing 3256810272264745 carries a non-null originalPrice on every variant: the mapped SKU reads $23.91 against a $49.81 list, and the other three read $23.78/$49.55, $21.52/$44.84 and $21.70/$44.28. Under step 1 of the gate sequence a discounted listing passes only if it clears at BOTH prices, and this one does not clear at $49.81 at any price the category supports.

costHoldCeilings.note: Max supplier cost to clear the $12.00 floor at the live $72.00, from contribution() in scripts/us-duty-impact.mjs - not a collapsed formula. Verified by reproducing the catalogue figures 40.55/8.05 exactly at itemCost 23.91, supplierShip 1.84, dutyRate 0.414.

costHoldPriceNote: Separately: $72.00 is for a SINGLE sconce, against an Amazon page-1 median of $59.99 for a PAIR (six keywords, 47-48 organic results each, measured 2026-09-11). Sconces sell in pairs in this category, so there is no 2-pack premium to capture and rule 2 ceiling of $72.43 is worth re-deriving against that basket before this offer is released.
